mapper.select: select A.slug as slug, A.title as title, (select count(1) from article_favorites AF where AF.article_id = A.id) as favoritesCount from articles A where A.user_id = #{userId} order by A.created_at asc, A.slug asc
select count(1) from follows where follow_id = #{userId}
select count(1) from article_favorites where user_id = #{userId}
